sections.heading: Using the site
paragraphs: BONG aims to make its pages usable with a keyboard, clear headings, visible focus, meaningful labels and useful image descriptions.

sections.heading: Motion and text
paragraphs: The site respects your reduced motion preference and is designed to stay readable when you enlarge the text or use a small screen.

sections.heading: Known limits
paragraphs: Testing cannot find every accessibility barrier. Linked sites, including X and Telegram, are outside BONG’s control and may have their own accessibility limits.
